searchText: Gah. Stupid bot. Just create a PR against the EIP and the bot should auto-merge them. After slogging through 150 EIP emails and having 95% of them be ERCs... I'm starting to weaken my position on "we should just wait for the executable spec". 😖 <@425279588009246720> are you opposed to https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5026 being merged? (it was, accidentally)
